data.title: 芙莉莲 · 旷野旅途·苍月草的花海
data.description: 【芙莉莲 · 旷野旅途·苍月草的花海】午后，中央诸国的缓坡铺满盛开的蔚蓝苍月草，近处花簇环绕花间窄径，远处花海连向天际。芙莉莲手握法杖独自行走，白色斗篷和银白双马尾随风轻扬；她回首望向画面外的同行者，神情平静——「精灵的时间很长，人类的一生很短。但既然答应了陪你同行，无论接下来走多久，我都会记着这段旅程。」
data.action: 手持法杖沿苍月草花海中的窄径行走，回首望向画面外的同行者，斗篷随风扬起
data.lighting: 午后天光从画面右后方照亮蓝色花瓣、银发与斗篷边缘，花丛间保留柔和阴影
data.camera: wide shot, low angle, dense blue blossoms fill the foreground and extend behind Frieren to the horizon
data.promptProse: A vast sea of densely blooming blue flowers carpets the rolling meadow from the near foreground to the horizon. Large blue blossoms surround Frieren's legs and continue behind her in unbroken bands of flowers; only a narrow flower-lined footpath parts the meadow. Frieren walks along this path holding her staff in one hand and looks back over her shoulder toward her travelling companion outside the frame. The breeze lifts her pale travel cloak and silver-white twintails above practical trousers and boots. Frame her and the surrounding flower field together in a wide, low-angle view. Soft afternoon light from the upper right behind her catches the blue petal rims, silver hair and lifted cloak edge; gentle shadows remain between the flower clusters and beneath the cloak.
